parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that fits into the table frame, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: Provides storage space for small items and slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden drawer identical to the first, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space and slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: Moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel that connects the side panels and supports the structure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural rigidity and prevents lateral movement.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel forming part of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the tabletop and drawers, maintaining the table’s shape.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden bottom panel located beneath the drawers.

parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
